Hi Tom —

Thanks — we'd love to run the demo. Wanted to flag a DST caveat: Europe switched to DST on Sun 28 Mar, so our Berlin team is now on CEST (UTC+2). That means overlap math with PST (UTC-7) is a little tighter than usual. To make this concrete, here are three viable windows (all 45m):

Option A — US-friendly morning (your 09:00–09:45 PDT):
  - PDT: 09:00–09:45 (Tom/Maya)
  - CEST: 18:00–18:45 (Berlin team)
  - IST: 22:30–23:15 (Maya/APAC)

Option B — earlier CEST slot (earlier for us, late evening for you):
  - PDT: 07:30–08:15
  - CEST: 16:30–17:15
  - IST: 21:00–21:45

Option C — late night PST (if you prefer slightly later):
  - PDT: 10:30–11:15
  - CEST: 19:30–20:15
  - IST: 23:00–23:45

We're happy to run the full intro + live demo + Q&A agenda (attached short agenda). If you'd like, we can also split into a 30m product walkthrough + 15m technical deep-dive with our APAC engineer on call.

I'll loop in Laura (CS lead) to handle recording permissions and PrIyom for technical availability. If none of these work, tell me two concrete PST slots and we'll try to adjust.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
